page.title: Closed canopy
page.description: Closed canopy. Recorded at about 110 m in the Glenabo catchment, Fermoy, Co. Cork.

hero.title: Closed canopy.
hero.alt: Tall closely spaced conifers with bare lower trunks and no ground vegetation

blocks.text:
Even-aged conifer, planted close together. The lower trunks are bare and the floor is bare needle litter. This is a working crop, and it is doing the job it was planted for.

The nearest channel is twenty-three metres away.

blocks.heading: The name of this glen
blocks.text: An account written down at Adair school in the 1930s explains how Glenabo got its name. It names the glen, not this particular spot.
